candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits a non-policy analysis that preserves provenance-linked supporting and opposing claims without exclusions or mandates. The final call consumes that analysis, directly receives every common input, may reinterpret or reject any transmitted claim, independently reconciles obligations and evidence, and emits one complete policy.
candidate_structure.name: Symmetric Provenance Unitary Authority
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with an authority-free evidentiary edge and one final policy authority

calls.objective: Map provenance-linked supporting and opposing claims, preserve unresolved conflicts, and expose obligation-relevant uncertainty without adjudicating commitments or constructing a policy.

Consume map_symmetric_provenance, directly examine all common evidence, independently resolve transmitted conflicts without inherited edge authority, satisfy normative obligations, and emit one complete policy.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace the authority-bearing exclusion edge with a zero-authority symmetric-provenance edge whose claims and counterclaims remain rebuttable by the final role.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Final synthesis retains direct obligation visibility while gaining freedom to resolve conflicting evidence coherently, reducing premature commitment lock-in and improving policy validity.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The incumbent converts preliminary evidence reconciliation into binding negative authority, so uncertain exclusions can constrain final synthesis before all conflicts are resolved by the policy-producing role.

structural_mutation.after: The sole edge carries provenance-linked claims and counterclaims without veto, mandate, or commitment authority; the final role independently resolves them against directly visible common evidence.
structural_mutation.before: The sole edge carries binding exclusions that the final role may not reinstate.
structural_mutation.factor: zero-authority symmetric provenance on the sole analysis-to-policy edge
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes concrete edge authority and downstream control semantics from inherited veto to rebuttable evidence transmission while preserving one sequential lineage.
